name: Ring Band Creation Script - UK sizes Customizer

captions.detailed: A 3D model of a plain wedding band style ring, rendered in a solid gray color. The ring features a flat interior surface and a rounded exterior cross-section, forming a classic court or D-shape profile. The facets of the circular extrusion are visible, showing a low-to-medium polygon count that defines its roundness.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric ring band generator in OpenSCAD that allows customization of the ring size (using UK sizing converted to internal diameter), wall thickness, and band depth. The script should support multiple cross-section shapes, such as a half-pill shape, and allow optional engraved or raised text wrapping around the inside or outside of the band.
captions.factory: The script uses rotate_extrude() with a specified convexity to sweep a 2D profile around a central Z-axis, translated by half the ring's internal diameter. The 2D profile is determined by conditional logic (if/else) selecting from various shape modules (such as half_pill_shape) based on user input. Optional text engraving or raising is handled using a difference() or union() boolean operation with the writecylinder() helper from an external library.
